name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.2.0 Studio Major Update Ready!
• Full infinite scrolling across 200,000+ vector icons with mousewheel support & custom scrollbar
• Native vector animation in After Effects (Trim Paths & continuous rotation) for Line MD icons
• 3-tier emoji fallback: 0 broken emoji boxes (🫦 biting lip, 🫥 dotted face, etc.)
• Live dynamic counter & streamlined performance
